prompt_variants: Test the unreleased Nutshell change at https://github.com/cashubtc/nutshell/pull/1095. Build its exact PR head, then use that candidate as the mint in a disposable regtest lab with Bitcoin Core, LND 0.21, and a compatible Nutshell wallet. Bring the lab online, fund the wallet with 2048 sat through the normal mint flow, report its balance, export compact evidence with the PR commit and image digest, and fully tear down the lab. Use only Proofstorm.

Using only Proofstorm, try https://github.com/cashubtc/nutshell/pull/1095/ as a real mint. Let the candidate build continue through bounded waits, use its exact catalog version with Bitcoin Core, LND 0.21, and a compatible wallet, and complete a normal 3072 sat wallet funding flow. Report the result, preserve commit and image provenance in compact evidence, and remove the disposable lab.

Validate Nutshell PR https://github.com/cashubtc/nutshell/pull/1095 end to end. Build the frozen PR revision, select the resulting candidate mint version, and run it in the smallest useful Bitcoin Core plus LND 0.20 regtest lab with a compatible wallet. Fund 4096 sat into the wallet, report the observed balance, export evidence identifying the commit and image, then verify teardown. No operator commands.

Can the Nutshell code in https://github.com/cashubtc/nutshell/pull/1095/ actually run? Have Proofstorm build it and recover through repeated waits if necessary. Put the exact candidate mint in a disposable Bitcoin Core and LND 0.21 lab with a compatible wallet, complete a 1536 sat mint-funded wallet flow, capture compact provenance and runtime evidence, and clean everything up.

Build a disposable system that tests Nutshell Lightning payments at different routing fee rates. Use two Nutshell mints, one backed by LND and one by CLN, connected through a Lightning network. Test payments in both directions with routing fees below and above the mint's fee reserve. Report quote states, reserved and paid fees, balances, and whether value was conserved. Export evidence and fully tear down the lab.

Create an isolated regtest experiment with a Nutshell mint on LND and another on CLN. Route payments through an intermediate Lightning node in both directions. Compare a cheap route with a route whose fee exceeds the melt reserve, and show the observed quote states, fee reserve, actual fee, wallet balances, and conservation result. Preserve evidence, then remove everything you created.

Test 2,000 sat cross-mint payments between LND-backed and CLN-backed Nutshell mints. Exercise both directions first with about a 1 sat routing fee and then with about a 100 sat routing fee, keeping the mints' normal reserve behavior. Report the exact settlement and accounting observations, export evidence, and verify complete teardown.

Build a disposable regtest lab with one Bitcoin node and two directly connected LND nodes. Fund a channel, prove a Lightning payment can cross it, capture useful evidence, and fully tear down the lab.

Create the smallest useful CLN-to-CLN regtest network backed by Bitcoin Core. Open a funded channel, exercise connectivity and a payment-capable path, report what happened, export evidence, and verify that teardown removed the lab.

Build an isolated CDK mint lab that uses its supported embedded LDK Lightning backend rather than an external payment-backend node. Add a compatible wallet, prove a basic mint and payment workflow, explain the resolved dependencies, export evidence, and tear everything down.

Exercise a CDK mint with an embedded LDK backend on regtest using a compatible wallet. Do not invent an external payment_backend link when the catalog says the backend is embedded. Record balances and settlement evidence and finish with verified teardown.

Spin up a disposable regtest CDK-LDK mint and a wallet that works with it. Put 15,000 sats into the wallet through Lightning, demonstrate one payment, save enough evidence to support the result, and remove the lab when finished.

Create a disposable Lightning regtest lab, establish a working route, partition the route, demonstrate the expected loss of reachability, heal it, and demonstrate recovery. Export the ordered evidence and fully tear down the lab.

Build a small Bitcoin-backed Lightning network and test a node restart: establish healthy connectivity, restart one routing node, observe the interruption and recovery, preserve evidence, and verify complete teardown.

Build a disposable lab for a supported mint and wallet authentication flow. Exercise an authenticated spend and a replay attempt, report which actions were accepted or rejected with evidence, and fully tear down the lab.

Use Proofstorm to test replay protection for an authenticated mint operation in an isolated lab. Include the necessary identity dependency, capture conformance and replay observations, export evidence, and verify teardown.

Build a disposable Bitcoin, LND, Nutshell mint, and wallet lab. Use each component's native CLI in its real running container to show Bitcoin and Lightning are healthy. Restart the mint, verify it returns without losing its persistent state, export evidence, and tear the lab down.

Create a small regtest system using Bitcoin Core, CLN, a Nutshell mint, and a wallet. Prove bitcoin-cli and lightning-cli can talk to the actual running services, restart the wallet and mint, and show both recover. Keep offline inspection separate from commands that need a live process. Save evidence and remove the lab.

Make a disposable CDK-on-LND lab with a compatible wallet. Exercise a normal wallet flow, inspect one implementation detail offline, then run a native status command in the live LND container and restart the mint. Verify the lab still works, export evidence, and clean up.

Build a disposable cross-mint Nutshell payment lab and create an unroutable Lightning payment so the payer wallet has a failed or pending melt. Poll that exact payer-side melt quote through the wallet, show whether its reserved proofs are released, restart the payer mint and verify recovery, export evidence, and tear everything down.

Create a small regtest system with two independently backed mints and one wallet per mint, establish a funded cross-mint baseline, then break the Lightning route and attempt a payment. Reconcile the exact payer-side melt quote using the wallet's typed refresh operation and report before-and-after state, reserved proof count, and spendable balance. Restart the payer mint, preserve evidence, and fully clean up.

Plan a lab containing a mint that requires an unsupported payment backend and a channel whose requested outbound liquidity exceeds its funding. Do not materialize an invalid lab. Report the exact feasibility failures and compatible alternatives.

Ask Proofstorm to plan an impossible mixed implementation topology with incompatible wallet and mint versions. It must fail before materialization, explain the dependency mismatch, and suggest valid catalog alternatives without creating infrastructure.
